blocks.notes: Cells are 32x32 on alternating solid checker cells #47ffbb/#34bc88; the sheet surround is #2a966c with a #237f5a border - treat all four as transparent. The RIGHT row is a pixel-exact horizontal mirror of the LEFT row in every column except the flight cells. Same layout as goku.png for columns 0-53 (idle/blink, walk, run, three melee strings, teleport 22-27, blast 28-30, Kamehameha 31-33, overhead throw 34-37, hurt 38, X-block 39-40, power stance 41, level-up 42-45, swim 46-49, diagonal flight 50-53). Row lengths: down 60 cells (0-59), left/right 62 (0-61), up 54 (0-53) with up col 1 empty. RIPPER ROW MIX-UP at cols 42-45: down is correct, but the LEFT row holds the back view, the RIGHT row holds a mirrored back view and the UP row holds the left-facing side view. The main block therefore only exposes the down facing for raise/levelUp/cheer; the gokuSSJRaise block re-maps those rows correctly. FLIGHT IS DIAGONAL exactly as on goku.png: 'fly' omits right - mirror the left frames (= row 0); the up-left back-view row is kept as 'flyUpLeft'. KO: on the side rows 54 stagger, 55 thrown back sitting (still golden), 56 landing with the hair turning brown, 57 flat with black base-form hair - the knockout ends in base form. The down row only has 54 (gut-hit stagger) and 55 (thrown back, arms up), exposed as 'koFront'; down 56-59 are instead the standing power-down (golden, pale, brown, black hair). 'revert' is the SSJ-to-base power-down: standing on the down row (56-59), and on the side rows a collapse to a slumped sit as the hair goes pale (58), brown (59) and black (60-61). Hair recolour (e.g. Blue/God palettes): #e7a542, #ffff00 and #ffff39 are hair-only; #ad7b39 (hair outline, also a skin shade) and #ffffff (hair highlight, also eye whites and effects) are listed in paletteShared and should be recoloured only inside the hair region. Cells with no baked shadow: 23 and 46-53 on every row. The baked ground shadow is #000000 (outline colour) - strip it by geometry. Baked effects: white swoosh trails 11-21, sparkles 38-39 and 42-43, teleport fragments 23-26.
